summary: Iteration 2 — Tested newly added Understat player statistics feature (leaderboard players, player detail with breakdown, match players section, search, methodology, config). Extended pytest suite to 19 tests (all pass) covering 6 new player endpoints/scenarios. Frontend E2E via Playwright validated /classements 'Meilleurs joueurs' tab (100 rows sorted, breakdown modal on click), match detail PL 560578 'Joueurs à surveiller' section with 8 watch cards + clickable score bars opening breakdown, DED match 558894 shows 'Données joueurs indisponibles', search /?q=Mbapp returns 2 player results, /methodologie exposes 'Scores des joueurs' with buteur/creation weighting, and home matches grid still renders 63 cards.

issues: Radix Dialog console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — non-blocking a11y warning, easy fix by adding <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby.

action_items: (minor a11y) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to ScoreBreakdown Radix Dialog to silence a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: player_scoring.py: global breakdown includes 'Ajustement temps de jeu' as a contribution (+2..+20), which correctly closes the sum==score identity — good transparency.
server.py /api/leaderboard/players?code=PPL|DED returns 200 with disponible=false — consistent with equipes fallback pattern; keep this shape for stability.

Understat player names include diacritics (e.g., 'Kylian Mbappe-Lottin'). Search uses substring match and works for 'Mbapp'. Consider normalizing accents server-side for robustness (already sufficient today).
seed_data_creation: None — used already synced 2042 Understat players. Test IDs: player 8026 (Raphinha), match PL 560578, match DED 558894.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Player endpoints fully covered by pytest (test_leaderboard_players_all/by_code_pl/ppl_unavailable, test_player_detail_and_breakdown, test_match_players_available_pl, test_match_players_unavailable_ded, test_search_players, test_scoring_config with equipes+joueurs). Frontend selectors verified: tab-players, players-leaderboard, lb-player-{id}, players-section, player-watch-card-*, search-players, search-player-{id}, search-input-team-player. PL top-30 leaderboard contained Raphinha (rank 1, score 96), Yamal (2, 87), Mbappé (3, 82). DED/PPL correctly return disponible=false. All scores /100, sum(composantes.contribution) == global.score exactly within ±2.
